title: William "Frank" Mays killed in Ohio City bike lane
summary: William "Frank" Mays, 35, of Highland Hills, was killed about 4:50 p.m. on Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026, while riding in the marked bike lane near Detroit Avenue and West 25th Street in Ohio City, Cleveland. The Cuyahoga County Prosecutor's Office said Tyrelle Taylor, 26, was fleeing Cleveland police in a 2010 Ford F-150 Raptor when a front wheel broke off.
